notes.title: Get to know Cyn Deh
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42830109/a36b1bfddf3840b393dd3ff92afc2b3912ff1535.png[/img]

Cyn Deh one of the monks who dwell in the Temple of Renewal. He is deeply loyal to Varga, his mentor whom he assists in his everyday life.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42830109/8b3a2b5cf165be5673206d5f735efa2f9425a151.png[/img]

He is not thrilled at the prospect of living with Rhodias, who he dislikes at first sight. His sense of duty nonetheless makes him carry on the task of showing Rhodias around the temple and seeing that he is welcome in the community.

Make closer acquaintance with Cyn Deh and download the [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/symbiant-ii-demo-131783084]free 4K CG pack of The Symbiant II's demo here[/url]!
